data-disabled.description: Present when the submenu trigger is disabled.

data-highlighted.description: Present when the submenu trigger is highlighted.

data-popup-open.description: Present when the corresponding submenu is open.

description:
A menu item that opens a submenu.
Renders a `<div>` element.
name: MenuSubmenuTrigger

className.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component’s state.

closeDelay.description:
How long to wait before closing the menu that was opened on hover.
Specified in milliseconds.

Requires the `openOnHover` prop.

delay.description:
How long to wait before the menu may be opened on hover. Specified in milliseconds.

Requires the `openOnHover` prop.

disabled.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

label.description: Overrides the text label to use when the item is matched during keyboard text navigation.

nativeButton.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.

openOnHover.description: Whether the menu should also open when the trigger is hovered.
